# blender-stop-condition-decider

Purpose: Define explicit "done" conditions for a Blender recipe before starting work, so the agent stops at the right point instead of drifting into endless polish.

Pin a single, explicit stop condition for one recipe BEFORE work begins—consisting of one concrete sentence, an explicit out-of-scope list, and a handoff trigger—so the agent stops at the right point instead of drifting into endless polish. Firing the stop condition routes the deliverable to the next skill; it never upgrades any runtime or artifact truth state. Inspired by Anthropic Superpowers `/just-say-when-it's-done` analog.

Metadata: Category `process-discipline` | Role `done-condition-and-iteration-cap-pinner` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- BEFORE starting work on any non-trivial single Blender recipe
- after `blender-recipe-decomposer` has isolated a single recipe and `acceptance-criteria-builder` has provided measurable acceptance rows
- when previous attempts drifted into endless polish or unclear completion boundaries
- Trigger phrases: "when are we done", "let's set the bar", "what does done look like"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- pure exploration or brainstorming → use `blender-brainstorming` (`references/skill-blender-brainstorming.md`; use blender-brainstorming; goal is divergence)
- tiny single-shot requests → use `intent-to-3d-brief-writer` (`references/skill-intent-to-3d-brief-writer.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to intent-to-3d-brief-writer)
- splitting a broad multi-recipe request beforehand → use `blender-recipe-decomposer` (`references/skill-blender-recipe-decomposer.md`; use blender-recipe-decomposer first)
- authoring measurable acceptance rows from scratch → use `acceptance-criteria-builder` (`references/skill-acceptance-criteria-builder.md`; use acceptance-criteria-builder first)
- enforcing per-stage checklist gates during execution → use `blender-checklist-driven-workflow` (`references/skill-blender-checklist-driven-workflow.md`; use blender-checklist-driven-workflow)
- after work has already started and scope is drifting mid-flight → use `blender-scope-boundary-enforcer` (`references/skill-blender-scope-boundary-enforcer.md`; use blender-scope-boundary-enforcer)
- performing the final verification gate before delivery → use `pre-handoff-verification` (`references/skill-pre-handoff-verification.md`; use pre-handoff-verification)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `locked_3d_brief` (`object`): Locked 8-slot 3D brief defining deliverable intent
- Required input `acceptance_criteria_rows` (`array`): Measurable Pass/Warn/Fail criteria from acceptance-criteria-builder
- Optional input `iteration_budget_preference` (`integer`): Maximum refinement passes before halting or escalating
- Output contract: `definition_of_done_checklist`, `max_iteration_caps_per_stage`, `halt_and_escalation_triggers` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Quick-start steps
1. write one stop condition per recipe (one sentence, concrete)
2. write what is OUT OF SCOPE for "done"
3. write the handoff trigger (which skill receives the deliverable when stop condition fires)
4. enforce: do not polish past the stop condition; do not declare done before it

## Cross-skill handoffs
- [upstream_reference] Intent brief → `intent-to-3d-brief-writer` (`references/skill-intent-to-3d-brief-writer.md`)
- [boundary_delegation] Scope splitting beforehand → `blender-recipe-decomposer` (`references/skill-blender-recipe-decomposer.md`)
- [upstream_reference] Measurable acceptance rows → `acceptance-criteria-builder` (`references/skill-acceptance-criteria-builder.md`)
- [progression] Per-stage workflow gates → `blender-checklist-driven-workflow` (`references/skill-blender-checklist-driven-workflow.md`)
- [progression] Mid-flight scope drift → `blender-scope-boundary-enforcer` (`references/skill-blender-scope-boundary-enforcer.md`)
- [progression] Artifact and render evidence → `render-export-evidence` (`references/skill-render-export-evidence.md`)
- [progression] Final pre-handoff gate → `pre-handoff-verification` (`references/skill-pre-handoff-verification.md`)

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: Process and discipline skill only—no Python code and no Blender execution. This skill writes the stop condition before work starts and routes handoff when the condition is met; it never executes runtime tasks or upgrades truth states.
- Run Blender or execute Python.
- Split multi-recipe scope (`blender-recipe-decomposer`).
- Author raw measurable acceptance rows (`acceptance-criteria-builder`).
- Enforce per-stage checklist gates (`blender-checklist-driven-workflow`).
- Police mid-flight scope drift (`blender-scope-boundary-enforcer`).
- Gate the final delivery (`pre-handoff-verification`) or upgrade runtime/artifact truth states.
